title: Timesheets View only: timesheet entries are read-only
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with Timesheets View ON and Create & Edit OFF, and Reports ON.
  2. The user appears on the technician schedule.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open a work order's timesheet section, or open the timesheet activities report from Reports.
  2. Look at the timesheet entries.
  3. Look for any way to edit an entry.
custom_expected:
The timesheet entries are shown.

There is no way to edit them (read-only).
evidence: UI (Time Clock User = timesheetsView only): the WO Timesheets tab shows entries but has no edit/add/delete affordances (read-only). screenshot ts-TCUview.
